_comment: Llama 3.1 8B single-node thresholds for MI455X Megatron. MI455X is unreleased hardware with no calibrated numbers yet. enforce_thresholds is false in the sibling config, so these are record-only until recalibrated. Cell keys must match MegatronVariantConfig.cell_key() format: MBS=<mbs>,GBS=<gbs>,PRECISION=<precision>.
